text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Autumn). The first battle 
of the Senior autumn/winter 
medium-distance GⅠ campaign has finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of the standout Umamusume is obviously 
Symboli Kris S, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*drool*~☆ It's irresistible. That posture, 
an appearance with maxed-out exoticness!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san! I want to be your target! I'd 
even wear a bullseye for you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You're so right. She's just so cooool...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times we run together, 
I can't help but stare. To think we're 
both Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Hishi Miracle-san!? You're more than 
worthy of being worshiped too, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that's not it at all~ Guess I'm just 
a bit different, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, same as always. Both Kris S-chan 
and Digital-chan look so dazzling...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Still, that doesn't mean I'll lose my 
nerve. Nor do I intend to push myself 
recklessly.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I'll just be myself and do what I 
can...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Nice to work with you, Kris S-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, in the paddock, I think I can at 
least manage a greeting now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Hishi Miracle. Ever since when was it...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
When I turn around—you are there. There is 
no doubt about your strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: However... she's elusive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What is――the Mission?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...A mission?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes—there must be a Mission.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mission... My mission...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Digital-chan... When you say 
mission...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What did that mean again?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that, right? Like the objective to 
beat a game.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I see, my purpose...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Was there something like that? I'm not 
like Kris S-chan, you know~."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see. If you have "No idea"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'll see for myself, right there in the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, yeah... Do I have one? Do I...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle is suddenly presented with a 
tough challenge. Up until now, she had 
just been running with all her might, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Can I truly find the meaning of 
running—within the race?
